While total revenue grew 5% to £1,625m and headline net debt improved to £325m, the profit decline from £108m to £76m reflects challenging operational headwinds including UK contract renewals, inflation and macro pressures. For FY27, the company expects headline PBT in line with market expectations of £75m-£85m. Current trading (first 10 weeks) is flat on LFL basis, described as 'in line with the Group's expectations'. No guidance upgrade occurred.
metrics_ahead: Headline net debt reduced from £390m to £325m

results.headline: H1: double-digit profit growth and higher margins
results.key_quote: We have delivered solid first-half results, improving profitability through execution and efficiency...Our engineering, test and mission support capabilities put us at the heart of growing customer demand for warfighting readiness.
results.summary: QinetiQ delivered H1 FY27 results ahead of expectations with double-digit underlying operating profit growth of 14% to £110m and operating margin improvement of 120bps to 11.9%. Revenue grew 3% and EPS grew 18%. The company confirmed full-year guidance and announced enhanced shareholder returns including a 33% higher interim dividend and £100m additional buyback commitment. While full-year guidance was maintained (not upgraded), the strong H1 execution with significant profit growth, margin expansion, and robust ROCE improvement of 20ppts to 41% demonstrates performance exceeding typical expectations for the period.
metrics_ahead: Return on capital employed improved 20ppts to 41%

results.headline: Interim results for six months ended 30 June 2026
results.key_quote: The Group's principal focus is oil exploration and production...The prize with our oil & gas assets remains demonstrating that either or both the BNG and Block 8 Contract Areas have production capabilities similar to the nearby world class Tengiz and Kashagan assets.
results.summary: Caspian Sunrise reported interim results for H1 2026 showing significant operational challenges with revenue collapsing from $3.3m (2025) to $0.1m and operating losses widening from $1.8m to $3.7m. Cash position declined from $23.3m to $11.9m. However, the company announced several strategic acquisitions and operational milestones (Block 8 acquisition, first oil at West Shalva, encouraging Deep Well 803 results, three new wells spudded). No explicit comparison to market or analyst expectations is provided in the announcement; results are presented as part of ongoing strategic repositioning rather than measured against forecasts.

results.headline: Strategic Update and Directorate Change
results.key_quote: Adjusted EBITDA for FY26 remains in line with market expectations. Significant pipeline opportunities nearing completion in Q4 2026 with FY26 revenue broadly in line with market expectations.
results.summary: Ingenta reports FY26 adjusted EBITDA and revenue both in line with market expectations. While the company is losing £2m in revenue from two contracts with its largest customer in 2027, the Board expects this to be largely offset by efficiency savings and AI-focused business refocusing. The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with £4.6m cash. Results are aligned with expectations rather than ahead of or below them.

results.headline: Half year trading update
results.key_quote: These results show some areas of progress, but we are clear about the challenges and underlying pressures on our operating performance.
results.summary: Operating performance significantly deteriorated with operating surplus falling 45% from £78.3m to £42.9m in H1 2026/27, despite a modest 3.2% turnover increase to £361.4m. The interim CEO explicitly acknowledged challenges and pressures on operating performance. While turnover grew and regulatory compliance was maintained, the substantial decline in profitability, combined with management commentary about cost control issues and operational challenges, indicates performance was below expectations for a housing association of this scale. Credit ratings were downgraded to negative outlooks across all three agencies (S&P, Fitch, Moody's).

results.headline: Q3 and YTD 2026 Financial Results
results.key_quote: Record quarterly and nine-month EBITDA and on track to achieve FY2026 guidance
results.summary: Atalaya delivered record Q3 2026 EBITDA of €90.1 million and YTD 2026 EBITDA of €216.3 million, both new records for the company. The company remains on track to achieve its FY2026 production and cost guidance. CEO Alberto Lavandeira stated results have 'delivered another excellent quarter of financial performance' with EBITDA records. While copper production is at the low end of guidance range, the company is maintaining its Cash Cost and AISC guidance targets despite cost pressures. Strong financial performance with net cash increasing to €342 million demonstrates results are tracking ahead of expectations.
metrics_ahead: Strong balance sheet with net cash of €342 million
Outperforming on cost guidance despite consumable price pressures

results.headline: Q3 and 9M 2026 Results
results.key_quote: Q3 saw improvement in the RASK/CASK growth differential for the third consecutive quarter...while cost pressures continue to impact the Group...EBITDAR margin was 4.0pp lower at 20.0%
results.summary: Q3 revenue growth of 20.6% YoY and RASK improvement represent strong top-line performance ahead of typical expectations. However, this is offset by deteriorating profitability metrics: Q3 EBITDAR margin declined 4.0pp YoY to 20.0%, CASK growth (20.0%) significantly outpaced RASK growth (16.0%), and PAT decreased 10.3% YoY. For 9M, EBITDAR declined 5.7%, margin fell 4.8pp, and the company swung to a loss (PAT -USD 2.7m vs +USD 31.2m prior year). Management acknowledges ongoing cost pressures but frames the improved RASK/CASK differential as positive. The guidance outlook is cautious, noting inflationary pressures will persist. Results show mixed performance: revenue and capacity metrics ahead, but profitability and margins significantly below prior year performance.
metrics_ahead: International expansion acceleration (capacity to China nearly doubled, India +23%)

results.key_quote: Significant near-surface gold mineralisation confirmed at Cedar Trench, with hole EG-26-07 intersecting 126.8m at 0.81 g/t Au, including 94.5m at 1.00 g/t Au and the previously reported high-grade intercept of 8.75m at 5.05 g/t Au.
results.summary: Gunsynd has announced an update on the Eagle Lake Project via Talon Resources' corporate announcement. Talon holds 90% of Wedgetail Mining Corp (which owns the project), with Gunsynd holding 10%. The announcement reports drilling results from the maiden exploration programme, including significant near-surface gold mineralisation at Cedar Trench. However, no comparison to expectations, guidance, or forecasts is provided. results.headline: Results analysis from Kepler Trust Intelligence
results.key_quote: NAV total return of 19.0% for the year to 31/08/2026, against the FTSE All-Share's 21.3%
results.summary: SCF reported an NAV total return of 19.0%, which underperformed the FTSE All-Share benchmark of 21.3% over the year. However, the share price total return was stronger at 23.0%, aided by discount narrowing and buybacks. Over the longer term (since July 2011), SCF has delivered annualised NAV total return of 8.7%, ahead of the FTSE All-Share's 8.1%. The fund raised its dividend by 4.1%, extending its 31-year consecutive dividend growth record and staying ahead of inflation. Challenges included holdings like Diageo and Taylor Wimpey cutting dividends, with dividend cover at 0.89x. The fund's performance is characterized as 'good results for income investors' with no explicit statement that results beat formal expectations.
metrics_ahead: longer-term annualised NAV return (8.7% vs 8.1% benchmark since 2011)
